verdict.rationale: Composio documents first-party allowlisting at two levels. Sessions can be restricted to specific toolkits via `toolkits`, where the default is otherwise the full catalog. MCP servers can be limited to exact tools via `allowed_tools`, or the direct-tools preset can serve only the listed tools. Missing for 10: role- or user-based access policies or denylists beyond static allowlists, documentation of how restrictions are enforced or audited, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control

citations.quote: To restrict the set, pass `toolkits` when you create the session.

By default, a session has access to every toolkit in the Composio catalog. Your agent can discover and use any of them through COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS. Use the options below to restrict or customize what's available.
Combine `mcp: true` with the direct-tools preset to get one MCP URL that serves exactly the tools you list
